# Rejected Field Archive proof — d3e2a89

Status: **rejected by the maintainer; historical evidence only**.

This proof corrected the dominant geometry but still rendered the approved
concept through a regular-width Material type system. It also retained
non-concept full-height green bay rails, generic semantic icons and Planning
choice treatments, a visible utility overflow control, an incomplete Today
cell, undersized index tabs, and extra placement/attention affordances.

These captures must not be used as an acceptance or golden baseline. The
untouched approved issue #118 concept remains normative.
